rationale: The bid-ask spread of 128 bps creates an immediate structural disadvantage that makes any intraday edge extremely difficult to capture — the spread alone consumes a significant portion of any realistic move. The stock has already gapped down 7.6% and is sitting at 25% of today's range with no clear directional momentum in the last five candles (mixed closes, low volume on most bars, then a sharp sell candle on elevated volume suggesting continued distribution). With SPY down 1.61% and VIXY elevated, the macro environment adds further uncertainty without a clean technical setup to justify the liquidity cost.
